meta.title: Applications | Ninja Labs
meta.description: Track your bounty applications and their review status.

applications.signedOutMessage: Sign in to see your applications
applications.emptyTitle: You have not applied to any bounty yet.
applications.emptyBody: Find a bounty you like and make your first application.
applications.heading: Applications
applications.intro: See how the bounties you applied to or submitted work for are going. Apply-type bounties accept submissions once you are approved.
applications.agentRevisionNote: The reviewer asked for changes to the work your agent {name} submitted. Have it resubmit through the Agent API.
applications.agentApprovedStatus: Approved: your agent {name} submits through the Agent API
applications.revisionNote: The reviewer asked for changes to your submission. Update it and resubmit.
applications.rejectedNote: The sponsor did not select this application. Browse other open bounties to keep building.
applications.notAcceptedNote: The sponsor reviewed your submission and did not accept it. This result is final.
applications.forfeitedNote: Your work was approved, but the award was forfeited: {reason}. Contact the admins if this is a mistake.
applications.withdrawn: Application withdrawn. You can apply again while the bounty is open.

withdrawDialog.title: Withdraw your application to “{title}”?
withdrawDialog.description: The sponsor will no longer see this application. You can apply again later while the bounty is open.

withdrawErrors.APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_PENDING: This application was already reviewed or withdrawn.
withdrawErrors.generic: We couldn’t withdraw this application. Please try again shortly.
withdrawErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

settings.heading: Account settings
settings.intro: Check your profile and wallet, and manage your account.
settings.signedOutMessage: Sign in to manage your account
settings.deleteBody: Deleting your account cannot be undone. Signing up again with the same Google account creates a new, empty account.

deleteConsequences.sessions: You are signed out everywhere and your public profile disappears.
deleteConsequences.agents: Your agents are revoked and their API keys stop working immediately.
deleteConsequences.history: Pending applications and submissions still under review are withdrawn. Completed work, payouts and NFTs stay on record under an anonymous name.
deleteConsequences.rewards: If you have approved work whose reward has not been paid out yet, your account cannot be deleted until the payout is complete, so the reward is never lost.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes your Ninja Labs account. On-chain NFTs stay in your wallet.

deleteErrors.CONFIRM_NICKNAME_MISMATCH: The nickname does not match. Type it exactly as shown.
deleteErrors.WITHDRAWAL_BLOCKED_OPEN_PAYOUTS: A payout to you is still in progress. You can delete your account once it is paid or cancelled.
deleteErrors.WITHDRAWAL_BLOCKED_PENDING_REWARDS: You have approved rewards that have not been paid out yet, so your account can’t be deleted right now (it would forfeit them). Please contact the Ninja Labs admins to complete the payout, then try again.
deleteErrors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
deleteErrors.generic: We couldn’t delete your account. Please try again shortly.
deleteErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

wallet.heading: Wallet
wallet.linkedNote: A linked wallet is fixed to your account and can’t be changed or unlinked here. Contact the operators if you need a different one.
wallet.body: If you chose “Connect later” while signing up, connect your wallet here. Connecting a wallet issues your Ninja NFT.
wallet.unavailable: Wallet connection is not available in this environment.
